I have farmed in Iringa for 78 years, and I went to school long enough to read what is on a seed packet, but my pocket decides everything. This plot is only 0.14 hectares, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer — one bag is too expensive for such a small piece and I need my cash for my bigger plots. I will spread manure from my cattle instead, and I will plant my own kept seed because without fertilizer there is no use paying for hybrid. My children and grandchildren will help me weed and harvest, so I do not need hired labor, and I will not irrigate because the rains come in season.
